key.description: The merchant key that was provided by PayU.

command.description: The API command opgsp_upload_invoice_awb must be specified for this parameter..

var1.description: The PayU ID or mihpayid of the transaction must be specified in this field. The Invoice or AWB will be uploaded basis of the PayU ID.

var2.description: The invoice ID or AWB ID is specified in this parameter. Alphanumeric with special characters is allowed.

var3.description: The type of document to be uploaded is specified in this field, and it can be any of the following: Invoice or AWB

File.description: The absolute path of the file to be uploaded is specified in this parameter. The maximum size supported is 2 MB and the following formats are supported: PDF (pdf), Document (doc or docx), or Image (jpg or jpeg)).

hash.description: The hash string calculated using the following logic: sha512(key|command|var1|salt) sha512
